object.body:
Hello ${__recipient.alias},


As a result of a recent maintenance event in our demo environment, you need to take some action to use your SailPoint tenant. Please be aware that it may take a few hours to accomplish these tasks.

Your username is: ${__recipient.alias}


Instructions


Step 1 - Network access
As an added security layer, only known IP addresses are allowed to access the demo environment. To accomplish this, please submit your company’s IP address range by using this form. In the future, you can maintain this list in your tenant. Go to Admin – System Settings – Network Settings and add the client/partners IP address range to the CIDR Notations.


Do not proceed to the next step until you receive an email that these have been added.

Step 2 - Register
Once you have received the email informing you that your IP address range has been added, please visit this link to re-register: Register Now

Step 3 – VA Creation
After accessing your tenant, please follow the below steps to bring your VA back online
· You will need to create a new VA for your tenant (do not try to re-use the old)
· You will need to run va-bootstrap reset to reset the existing VA and run through the pairing steps again

Step 4 – Re-enter application credentials
All applications will need to be reauthenticated prior to aggregation. Please edit each source configuration, re-enter the service account credentials, test the connection, and save the configuration.

Step 5 – Other secrets and Personal Access Tokens
All secrets. Personal Access Tokens or API keys need to be recreated.

If you see an issue with your tenant that you are unable to resolve, please open Support Ticket.

Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
